items.title: Queenslander could face death penalty over alleged killing of Australian in Syria
items.description: A 20-year-old Gold Coast mobile phone technician is facing a possible death penalty in Syria for the alleged shooting murder of another Australian.

items.title: Investors gave Capital Guard $17 million for a bond scheme that didn't exist
items.description: Everyday Australians who invested their retirement savings and inheritances with a wealth management company fear they have lost everything after the company's licence was cancelled for selling bank bonds that didn’t exist.

items.title: Breaking: Mother attended police station day before murder-suicide, search for baby called off
items.description: The mother at the centre of the horrific murder-suicide in South Australia's South East attended a police station the day before she and her daughter were found dead, police have confirmed.

items.title: Taiwan to stop buying PNG gas on spot market over 'One China' spat
items.description: Taiwan suspends some liquefied natural gas purchases from Papua New Guinea as part of an escalating diplomatic dispute over the future of its representative office in Port Moresby.

items.title: Drone captures rare video of 'magical moment' whale birth
items.description: A drone operator has captured video of a humpback whale giving birth, one of only a handful of people to film the phenomenon.

items.title: Inflation softer than expected in June but still 'uncomfortably high'
items.description: Headline inflation was softer than expected in June, but the RBA could still debate what to do with interest rates next month.

items.title: Staffer to whom Brittany Higgins first confided rape allegation settles case
items.description: A former political staffer has settled a contentious lawsuit with the Commonwealth over claims her workplace rights were compromised in the fallout of Brittany Higgins's rape allegation.

items.title: One Nation asked to submit three years of missing financial statements
items.description: The Office of Fair Trading confirmed that One Nation Queensland Division Inc had until midway through next month to file audited accounts for the financial years from 2023 to 2025.

items.title: Woman born after IVF error hopes for change after legal action launched
items.description: The biological parents of twins who were born after an IVF embryo mix-up at Royal North Shore Hospital in Sydney have launched civil action.

items.title: Local transmission of H5 bird flu confirmed in Australia
items.description: Federal agriculture minister Julie Collins says "local transmission has occurred" between greater crested terns infected with H5 bird flu in South Australia.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
